title: Lens Chinese-to-English translation response
description: The object the model is asked to return inside choices[0].message.content. The only channel whose result carries one language: the input is Chinese, so the reader's own explanation language is the one answer that cannot be right, and asking for it too would double the answer to pay for a line nobody draws.

results.description: One entry per request, in request order. No echoed title: the app stamps the selected text onto the result.

en.description: The English translation of the selected Chinese.
